༄༅/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang sngags zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' brgyud bla mar gsol 'debs brgyud 'dzin mchog rga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang sngags zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' brgyud bla mar gsol 'debs brgyud 'dzin mchog rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// yan lag bdun ldan bcom ldan dus 'khor lo// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// e wam̐ rdo rje 'chang dbang shākya thub// rgyal ba gnyis pa gsang bdag zla ba bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dang khro bo che'i// rnam 'phrul chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu lngar// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// grub pa yongs gtso dus zhabs 'jam rdo rje// mkhas grub dus 'khor bha dra pa yab sras// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// mkhas shing mchog gzigs paṇa chen zla ba mgon// 'jig rten mig gyur 'bro lo shes rab grags// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// rdzogs sbyor lam gyi grub brnyes dkon mchog srung*// mkha' 'gros mchod gyur dpa' bo gnam la brtsegs// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// 'dul 'dzin ye shes che brnyes dad pa'i rgyal// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul chos dbang phyug /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// lhag lhas rjes bzung mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od// mkha' spyod yongs gtso 'ja' lus jo 'bum la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// sa bcu'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa// 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung shes rab 'od// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// sangs rgyas rab gsal ngo bo chos 'od zer// rigs ldan rnam 'phrul kun spangs zhang brtson 'grus// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes pa// mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug yon tan mtsho// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// pad dkar 'chang dngos kun mkhyen dol po pa// de bstan 'dzin mkhas phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// smra ba'i seng ge nya dbon kun dga' dpal// 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor grub chen kun blo gros// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// lung rtogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs dkon cog bzang*// nges don gsal sgron nam mkha' chos skyong mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// gnas lnga rig pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po// 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul yongs grags rin chen bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// 'jam mgon grub pa spyod 'chang grol mchog zhabs// 'dul 'dzin mkhas grub lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sde// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// 'jigs med shing rta kun snying rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal tshab gnas brtan rin chen rgya mtsho'i sde// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// zab lam bstan pa'i srog 'dzin blo gros rgyal// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ngag dbang phrin las dpal// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje kun bzang dbang*// rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sde// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// mañdzu shrī dngos chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs// rgyal sras thu bo thugs kyi rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// gdul byar thar lam mchog gyur phyag rgya che// ston mdzad mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// rgyud sde'i mthar thug yi dam yongs kyi gtso// dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan rdo rje sems// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// rgyud kyi bdag mo rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya// bar chad sel mdzad srung ma drug cu la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// de ltar zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor che'i// brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab mthus// gang gi thugs rjes bdag blo dad pa dang*// nges 'byung lhag bsam rnam dag sdom gsum brtan// brgyud pa 'dzin mthus gzhan stong lta ba'i gnad// ji bzhin blor chud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor lam// bsgom pas tshe gcig nyid la dbang bzhi'i don// ma nor rdor sems 'bras bu thob byin rlobs//

zhes pa rgyud rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus lho phyogs kyi sham+bha la jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod du shing stag nag zla'i tshes nyer gsum la chos 'chad pa'i thun skabs gcig tu brjod pa'o// kha skong pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos so// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// / ༈ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi ngag 'don bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ gang zhig srid dang zhi ba'i dngos po rnams// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i dbyings nyid du// rgyas gdab lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog /mngon par gsal ston dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// dus gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi// 'jug ngogs bla na med pa yi// zab mo'i lam mchog 'dir gus rnams// sngon 'gro'i chos la 'bad par rigs// de yang gang zag skal ba mchog dang ldan zhing dad mos dam tshig can gyis zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la rgyud snod rung du bya phyir thun mong sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi rim pa la lnga ste/ thog mar theg chen lam gyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa/ sdig sgrib bag chags sbyong byed rdor sems bskyed bzlas/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs phyir maṇ+ḍal mchod 'bul/ thugs rjes rgyud grol smin byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas dang*/ thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi ngag 'don mthar chags su bstar la/ dang po dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun tsam bcas/ sems rnal du phab nas/ dag pa'i zhing khams yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ lha'i gzhal yas khang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa rgya khyon bkod legs de'i dbus su/

dpag bsam ljon pa rtsa ba brtan la yal ga dang lo ma me tog dang 'bras bu rgyas pa'i steng du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ ngo bor rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku can la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad sprin ltar gtibs pa/ de la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor zhing*/ phyogs kyi sa gzhi la seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan re re gsal ba'i mdun du rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ g.yas su 'phags pa 'jam dpal nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang*/ g.yon du mchog zung gnyis sogs nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ rgyab phyogs su chos dkon mchog dam ba'i chos gsung rab glegs bam gyi rnam pa/ gdan khri rnams kyi bar mtshams su ye shes chos skyong rnams dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa thams cad srung skyob kyi tshul du bzhugs par mos la/ de rnams kyi drung du lhan cig ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis skyabs yul rnams kyis yon tan dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ rigs drug sems can gyi sdug bsngal la snying rjes kun nas bslangs te thar pa'i gnas su drang ba'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la = /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// de ltar tshogs zhing rnams la blo gtad ling skyur gyis skyabs 'gro ci nus bya zhing*/

mthar/ bla ma dkon mchog rin po che khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog / ces brjod/ 'di skabs nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs yul rnams bsdus par bla ma'i sku'i mdun phyogs kyi sa gzhir pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid nyal bar mos te/ skyabs yul la mos gus bsgom bzhin pas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o// zhar byung gi man ngag go// de nas gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la blos gzhig btang nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad bde ba ltar snang nyi tshe ba'i ngang nas/ sdug bsngal mtha' med khor mo yug tu spyod bzhin pa la yid skyo shas dang bcas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i don bsgom pa rang rgyud la ci 'drer bya zhing ngag tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig / ngag tu ci nus brjod mthar dge bsngo bcas bya/ gsum pa rdor sems ni/ rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/

sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre ya/ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla zhing*/ sngags don dang mthun par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng zhal nang bstan de las bdud rtsi babs/ sku gang rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros/ sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi'i 'o rgyun babs/ rang lus shel bum gang ba ltar/ nad gdon bag chags dri ma phyir lud par dmigs nas mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ gnas lugs bskyang*/ bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags kyang yang yang 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ dngos 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'di skabs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas la rten 'byung gi ched du gtsor bton dgos pas/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i drung*/ mchod rdzas gang 'byor tshar du dngar ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal rgyu rin po che las grub pa sogs gang rnyed dang*/ dri bzang gi chu dang*/ 'bru sna la sogs pa bcas 'du byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal med khang dang skyabs yul tshogs zhing rnams sngar ltar dmigs la/ bdag gzhan sems can gyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces dang*/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi// de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas// mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pas steng du ni// blta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang*// khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*// khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do// khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi//

zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pas skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas lus kyi las su maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bkod/ yid kyi dmigs pa/ 'og gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i gling bzhi ri rab 'khor yug dang bcas pa/ steng phyogs srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khams gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i dngos po bzang la gya nom pas go mtshams med cing phyur bur bkang ste bla ma dkon mchog rnams la phul/ de'i rjes su bdag myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de dag gi skabs ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas// rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun tu mchod pa'i tshogs bcas la// blo yis dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'am/ sa gzhi spos sogs brjod/ tshul des maṇ+ḍal ci nus su phul/ thun 'jog khar/

mchod yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim/ ngo bo bskyang zhing dge bsngo sogs bya'o// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// sdig pa bshags so// dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o// skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub tu sems bskyed do// bla na med pa'i lam bsten par bgyi'o// bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol// zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bar 'dir spro na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs logs na yod pa rnams bya zhing*/ bsdus pa la dga' na ma byas kyang chog /nges par gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// de bzhin du sbyar te/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che la= /skyabs mchog mtshungs med=

/'dren mchog mtshungs med= /thar pa'i lam ston= /dngos grub 'byung gnas= /ma rig mun sel bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par= /sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar= /sgrub pa snying po nyams su longs par= /sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par=/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs bar= /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par= /nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar= /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mthar phyin par= /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar rgyang 'bod gsol 'debs snang ba 'gyur nges ci nus kyi mthar byin rlabs bsdu ba ni/ bla ma'i sku'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob// gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ hoḥlas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ chags rtog gi bag chags dag /bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi len pa grangs gsog tshe/ gong gi bla ma'i sku sogs nas bskyar zhing mthar/ slar yang mos gus dung ba dang yid kyis gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/

de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer ram bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag / dge bsngo sogs bya'o// gzhan yang*/ skye ba kun tu sogs smon lam rnam dag ci rigs pa'ang brjod/ sngags lam gyi nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs kho nas lam du byed dgos pas des na bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang bsten tshul/ mos gus dad pa'i phan yon sogs nges par byas nas nyams su ci nus len pa grub gnyis kyi rtsa ba mchog ste gal che'o// dmigs pa 'di'i yan lag nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la bla ma sku tshad tshon gang tsam dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal du bzhugs pa la mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang las gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o// de nas thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa lhan skyes nyid bsngags pas de'i sgom tshul ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang bas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang*/ sor tshigs rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang gnas su swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*// bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag / de ltar bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ swā hā/ ci nus dang*/ mthar/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod// de dag ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'dod don gsol gdab ni/ lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor gcod// nyams 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs gyur nas// lam sor sdud 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rlung sems ngag rnams mi g.yo zhing*// nyams shes rab rtog dpyod dga' bde 'phel// lam bsam gtan 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// rtsa ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar tshud// nyams gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu// lam srog rtsol 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// khams 'dzag med thig le dpral bar brten// nyams zhu bde 'gyur med rgyud la skyes// lam 'dzin pa 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// lus rtsa 'dab bde chen thig les gang*// nyams phyag rgya gsum la mnga' brnyes pa// lam rjes dran 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'o bka' drin gyis// rtsa 'khor lo drug po bde bas gang*// nyams spros pa med la dbang 'byor ba'i// lam ting 'dzin 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bder gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// lus byed bcings gnad dang ma bral zhing*// chos ma nor man ngag zab mo yis// lam sbyor drug 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs//

de nas bsngo ba/ chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi sogs/ smon lam ni/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med dus kyi 'khor lor ston// bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i 'od zer gyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i blo yi mun bsal nas// bde chen thar pa'i lam la 'god pa dang*// kun khyab bde chen snying po mngon gyur shog / bkra shis ni/ skyabs gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i dge legs dang*// don dam rtag brtan bde ba'i phun tshogs kyis// nges don snying po'i rgyud rgyal dus 'khor lo'i// phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang sbyor drug khrid rim gyi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don gzhung ji bzhin pa la cung zad gsal bar byas pa 'di ltar rgyal dbang mkhyen gzigs rin po che'i bka' bstsal ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa 'gro rnams rdo rje'i rnal 'byor chen po'i go 'phang mngon du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge zhing bkra shis/// /
